description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeSubordinateAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. It includes various test methods that verify functionality such as getting subordinate details, validation rules, creating, updating, deleting subordinate relationships, and mocking dependencies like services and data access objects.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSubordinateAPI, including tests for retrieving subordinate data, validation rules, creation, update, deletion, and mocking dependencies.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodService
methods.description: Tests that getEmployeeReportingMethodService returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Tests that getReportingMethodConfigurationService returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies fetching a subordinate's details and associated reporting method, mocking DAO and service layers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving a single subordinate, considering user permissions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving all subordinates for an employee.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of subordinate list for an employee, including normalization and metadata.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a subordinate relationship, ensuring DAO method is called and result is as expected.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates input data for creating subordinate relationships.

methods.name: testUpdate
